name: house-style
description: Injects your team's style guide (STYLE.md) into the system prompt automatically.

files.title: Style guide files
files.description: Comma-separated paths, relative to the project root, tried in order before the defaults (STYLE.md, .claude/style.md, docs/STYLE.md, CONTRIBUTING.md).

maxChars.title: Maximum characters
maxChars.description: The most of the guide that goes into the system prompt; longer guides are cut with a note.
